subject: Inference Product Offer: page narrative + SKU mapping (review)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 1 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft product page + SKU mapping for AcmeCorp offer — review requested

Team — attaching the draft one-pager and a preliminary SKU mapping for the AcmeCorp AWS listing. This is the marketplace offer that ties to the Acme deal (ACME-2028-237), and AWS asked us to finalize the public page copy and the SKUs we’ll expose for co-sell before 10/12.

Asks (quick):
- Can Kim and Marissa take a pass on the hero headline + 3 benefit bullets? We need a succinct narrative for the product page (customer-facing) and a slightly different sales-facing elevator for field copy.
- Ben / Laura: confirm the SKU bundling in the spreadsheet matches how we want to meter private offers (single-AMI vs per-inference-unit). There are pricing footnotes in column F.
- If anyone has objections to the trial wording, flag them — Acme specifically asked about a 30-day trial vs trial-by-usage.

Attachments: redwood-inference-product-one-pager.pdf, sku-mapping-quantized.xlsx

Thanks — I want to collate edits by EOD Wed (10/03) so we can send to AWS next week.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Partner GTM | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft product page + SKU mapping for AcmeCorp offer — review requested

Priyom — thanks for the draft. Quick inline notes below (kept them short so we can move fast).

On the hero:
- Current hero: "High-performance inference for production" — feels generic.
- Variant A (concise): "Predictable, low-latency inference across cloud & private environments"
- Variant B (benefit-first): "Reduce inference cost by 3x while keeping 99ms median latency" (only use if we can back the percent/latency in the listing evidence)

Bullets (customer-facing):
1) "Unified runtime that scales from dev to dedicated GPU pools"
2) "Intelligent batching & prefix caching to lower per-token cost"
3) "Operational visibility: per-model latency, token-level billing, and rollout controls"

Field elevator (2 lines):
"Redwood Inference provides a single API for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments with built-in observability and predictable economics — so your product team ships features without building inference ops."

SKU notes (skim):
- If we expose a single AMI SKU, we should have a clear private-offer mapping for reserved capacity bundles (see tab 'ReservedBundles').
- Column F footnote about 'burst capacity' should call out that burst is gated and billed differently; reword to: 'Burst capacity subject to reservation and usage caps; contact sales for private offer terms.'

Attached a short doc with hero-variants and small phrasing swaps: hero-variants.docx (minor).

LMK if you want me to propose the final hero copy or we pick Variant A and move forward.

— Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace Programs

From: Jesse Park <jesse.park@acmecorp.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft product page + SKU mapping for AcmeCorp offer — review requested

Hi Priyom — thanks for sharing. A couple quick clarifications from our side before you finalize with AWS: 

1) Trial model: we prefer trial-by-usage for Security approval (so we don't run into quotas). Can you confirm whether the public listing will advertise a "30-day trial" or "trial-by-usage"?
2) Billing: for our procurement team, the private offer needs per-tenant metering (meter per inference unit or per-hour reserved). Is the SKU mapping able to express both options?

If helpful, I can loop in Procurement; they are available to review the spreadsheet on Friday.

Thanks — Jesse
Jesse Park
Product Ops, AcmeCorp

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Oct 2028 10:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft product page + SKU mapping for AcmeCorp offer — review requested

Putting a short summary and next steps so we all have the same view: 

Summary:
- Kim: Variant A for hero looks good (concise, risk-averse).
- Marissa: field copy still needs one small case study line (I asked for a 20-30 word example).
- Pricing: we can support per-inference-unit metering and an optional reserved bundle (AMI-bundled) — spreadsheet now has both.
- Trial: Acme prefers trial-by-usage; recommend we list "Usage-based trial up to $X credit" on the marketplace page and leave the 30-day phrasing out.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Priyom: update one-pager with Variant A hero + Marissa's case line (due Mon 10/08).
- Laura: update sku-mapping-quantized.xlsx to add explicit metering codes for per-tenant usage (due Mon 10/08).
- Priyom/Ben: Confirm private-offer bundle text for the AWS doc submission (Ben will draft; due Tue 10/09).
- Priyom: get sign-off from Acme (Jesse) once above items are in.

HubSpot note: I added comments to the deal (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/ACME-2028-237) with the summary and assigned Laura + Priyom.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior AE | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jesse Park <jesse.park@acmecorp.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Oct 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final copy ready for AWS submission — sign-off request

Team / Jesse — thanks for the fast turn. Attached is the updated one-pager (hero Variant A) and the revised SKU mapping with explicit per-tenant metering codes and the reserved-bundle rows Laura added. Summary of updates below: 

- Hero: "Predictable, low-latency inference across cloud & private environments"
- Bullets: unified runtime, intelligent batching & prefix caching, and operational visibility (as Kim suggested)
- Trial: public page will state "Usage-based trial up to $2,000 in credits" (matches Acme procurement needs)
- SKUs: per-inference-unit meter + reserved AMI bundle; pricing footnotes clarified re: burst capacity and private-offer gating

Attachments: redwood-inference-product-one-pager.pdf, sku-mapping-quantized.xlsx

Please reply-all with a quick "LGTM" or any final objections by EOD Wed (10/10). If we get no responses, I'll proceed to publish the marketplace submission and loop in AWS Marketplace Ops for listing activation.

DocuSign & admin: once listing is ready, we'll push the private-offer paperwork via DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.com/links/ACME-marketplace-offer-2028).

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
